description:
Longchamp Paris Smoking Pipe Lot
Vintage Algerian Briar Collection
Leather-Wrapped, 3 Pieces, With Original Case
A vintage collection of smoking pipes from The Longchamp Pipe Company, Paris. Renowned for their signature leather-wrapped designs, Longchamp pipes were traditionally crafted using century-old Algerian briar, selected in the Jura mountains and hand-finished in Paris. This lot represents the classic mid-century French pipe-making tradition, highly regarded by collectors for the unique aesthetic and cooling properties of the leather dressing.
Items Included:
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Leather-wrapped briar bowl, straight black stem, marked Longchamp France.
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Cream-colored bowl with black bit, straight billiard-style silhouette.
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Leather-wrapped briar bowl, dark brown hand-sewn leather, black stem.
Original Presentation Case: Red exterior clamshell case with green velvet-style lining and branded silk interior lid.
Certificate of Authenticity: Original parchment document from The Longchamp Pipe Company certifying materials and origin.
Condition:
The pipes are in used vintage condition. Bowls show significant charring and carbon buildup from previous use. Stems exhibit tooth marks and light oxidation. The leather wrapping shows surface scuffs, discoloration, and age-related wear consistent with handling. The presentation case has visible staining on the interior silk lining and light exterior shelf wear. The included certificate is folded and shows age-toning but remains fully legible. One slot in the case is vacant.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage

Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height

Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

Aqua, Clear, and Dark Grey, Early-to-Mid 20th Century
A substantial collection of vintage industrial glass insulators, including iconic Hemingray-42 models in classic aqua blue. These insulators were historically used on utility lines to prevent electricity loss. Today, they are prized for their heavy construction and industrial aesthetic.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray-42 aqua blue glass insulators
Clear glass insulators with threaded designs
Dark matte finish insulators, porcelain or composite
Decorative black metal scrollwork hangers
Condition:

description:
Bendos Action Figure Lot - 7 Pieces
Kid Galaxy, early 2000s Era
This collection features seven vintage Bendos action figures in their original retail packaging. Known for their "Action Figures with a Twist" tagline, Bendos gained popularity in the late 1990s and early 2000s for their flexible, wire-framed bodies that allowed for infinite posing. This lot represents a diverse cross-section of the line, including sports, classic monsters, and unique character themes, making it an excellent addition for collectors of early millennial toys.
Figures Included:
Hockey Goalie - Blue and yellow uniform with goalie mask and stick, in rectangular box
Sports Referee - Black and white striped jersey with oversized yellow whistle, in rectangular box
Frankenstein Monster - Green-skinned figure with classic flat-top hair and chain accessory, in tube packaging
Caveman - Figure wearing a brown faux-fur style outfit, in tube packaging
Skydiver/Pilot - Yellow and purple suit with goggles, in tube packaging
Medical X-Ray Figure - Character with a skeleton/medical chart overlay, in tube packaging
Bumblebee - Character in yellow and black striped outfit, housed in a unique clear display sphere
Condition:
All figures remain factory sealed in their original packaging. The rectangular boxes show light shelf wear including minor corner softening and slight creasing to the cardboard. The clear plastic tubes and sphere are intact with no major cracks, though some light surface scuffing from storage is present. The internal figures appear pristine with vibrant paint and no visible degradation of the flexible material.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

description:
This lot includes four petrified wood pieces weighing approximately 1 pound 6.4 ounces. Each piece measures between 3.25 and 5 inches. The specimens display natural wood grain texture with colors ranging from beige to brown. One piece has a polished end revealing internal structure, while others have rough, natural edges. Under UV light, the pieces exhibit fluorescence, highlighting their mineralized structure. All pieces are in natural condition with typical surface wear. Suitable for display, collecting, or educational use.

Petrified Wood and Agate Specimen Lot
Mineral Specimen Lot - 2 Pieces
Polished and Natural, Brown and Tan, Vintage
This mineral collector's lot features two distinct geological specimens showcasing the beauty of silicified minerals. The first is a rectangular block of polished banded stone, possibly jasper or agatized petrified wood, featuring rhythmic wavy bands of sienna, tan, and cream with a translucent agate corner. The second is a natural rough specimen of petrified wood showing dark internal wood-grain patterns and a characteristic stone-hard fossilized texture.
Polished block displays intricate wavy banding and a translucent agate section at one end
Rough specimen exhibits dark carbon-rich fossilized wood grain and bark-like outer texture
Heavy stone-hard composition consistent with silica-replaced fossilized material
Polished block measures approximately 7 inches in length; total lot weight 2 pounds

Whether gifting or enhancing your own space, this stand provides a timeless, handcrafted look for your home

Natural Mineral Specimens

Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point

description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
